incremental_validation.scope: local synthetic fixtures; not full OccuSG pipeline parity
incremental_validation.backend_rejection_policy: no fresh RegionObservation; no M5 guard evaluation/commit or tracker update; return last M5-published snapshot stale with prior provenance; no native rollback claimed
incremental_validation.candidate_status_policy: success and fallback statuses enter M5 guard; source-accepted reuse branch is candidate update; M5 guard rejection preserves its own stale snapshot
incremental_validation.source_oracle: one persistent Incremental_Decomposer per multi-revision sequence; independent preprocessing and contour/world-output path
demo_rejection_sequence: accept_empty_free_space (M5 guard rejects initial empty candidate)
incremental_validation.successful_doorway_sequence: accept_incremental -> accept_incremental; region count 1 -> 2; symmetric raw adjacency 0<->1

m6_object_association.semantics: nearest normalized exact class first; else nearest same-pose suppression within min(radius, cap), both tie-break object ID; update last_seen/provenance only, preserve first-observation geometry/class/score
m6_object_association.provider_boundary: Detection3D center is already canonical world; DetectionBatch detections=None means absent, empty tuple means present frame with no detections

batch_atomicity.policy: prevalidate every detection world frame before any sequential association mutation
batch_atomicity.regressions: invalid second detection after first would create a node, and after first would match an existing node; snapshot/provenance/last_seen/ID allocator remain unchanged; next valid batch reuses expected ID
batch_atomicity.scope: API contract hardening; pinned matching algorithm unchanged

m7_navigation.profile: benchmark runtime YAML values: fs_cell_stride_cells=15, fs_min_free_cell_count=25, fs_navigation_connectivity=8; generic class defaults are 10/50/8
m7_navigation.semantics: world-aligned floor(cell_center/(stride*resolution)); count values == 0; create at >=25; representative free cell closest to block centroid with (row,col) tie-break; BFS through union of two blocks only; 8-neighbour; directed reciprocal NAVIGABLE_PATH edges
m7_navigation.lifecycle: same geometry retains nodes below threshold; origin/resolution change triggers full rescan and prunes nodes below threshold or outside current free blocks; surviving block IDs are stable world keys
m7_navigation.scope: structural cell connectivity only, not robot-footprint passability
m7_navigation.m3_integration: synthetic leaves projected by FreeSpaceGrid2D project_leaves Python debug port, then consumed by M7; not native C++ M3 parity

pytest.native_m2_m3_smoke: passed; OctoMapWorker integrate -> cpp_mapconverter full_refresh -> M7 graph invariants

contracts.promotion: current geometric region requires at least one meaningful direct member
contracts.adjacency: current region adjacency intersected with cross-region M7 navigation bridge; both regions must have RoomNodes

m8_rooms.lifecycle: stale snapshot skips relink/prune; accepted current snapshot relinks before pruning; retained but not current track does not protect missing anchor; expired track IDs are explicit
m8_rooms.geometry_scope: dependency-free simple-ring operations; holes supported by contract but M4 currently supplies only outer rings; self-intersection repair parity with upstream Shapely is not claimed

m7_to_m8_contract.adapter: room_entity_from_nav_node preserves NavNode.node_id, geometric block center, and footprint
m7_to_m8_contract.real_navnode_regressions: 0.75m block area 0.5625m2; negative/asymmetric world keys; candidate overlap choice; bridge-based room adjacency
m7_to_m8_contract.m4_m5_m8_integration: actual pinned local DuDe worker + M5 doorway sequence; synthetic agent/object/nav entities explicitly marked; stale rejection preserves rooms and IDs
m7_to_m8_contract.scope: module-boundary integration fixtures; not Habitat/Webots end-to-end; no complex-contour source parity claim
m7_to_m8_contract.bounds_validation: finite numeric exact 4-tuple, min_x < max_x and min_y < max_y; reject degeneracy

orchestration_maintenance.api: RoomAnchoringManager.update(..., maintenance=False) skips only relink/prune; membership resolution and promotion still run
orchestration_maintenance.cadence: SceneGraphBuilder gates maintenance through maintenance_due at configured 0.5 Hz; records pending accepted-snapshot work
orchestration_maintenance.flush: terminal flush runs pending maintenance once, applies one atomic GraphPatch, returns real deltas, then closes sequence

m9_pipeline.status: local ROS-free builder implemented; integration/contract milestone passed current fixtures, not full-system acceptance
m9_pipeline.semantics: single writer; strict packet mode contracts; monotone frame index/nondecreasing timestamps; consecutive revision GraphPatch; immutable graph snapshots and deltas; M6 absent-vs-empty; M7 structural nav only; M8 stale regions preserve anchors; terminal flush; M7 navigation edges reconciled by relation snapshot; room stale observation provenance preserved; NavNode first_seen stable; lifecycle closed after flush; post-stage exceptions poison builder with replay_required
m9_pipeline.stage_boundary: mapping and region stages constructor-injected; DudeM5RegionStage wraps actual pinned worker+M5 processor; no ROS/simulator dependency
m9_pipeline.transaction_limit: candidate snapshot, GraphPatch, GraphDelta and scheduler cursor are prepared before public graph/scheduler commit; delta-construction exceptions preserve last committed snapshot/revision/cursor; already-mutated M4/M5/M6/M7/M8 backend state is not rolled back and poisons builder for replay
m9_pipeline.metadata_policy: FramePacket.source_metadata and GraphNode.attributes accept only finite JSON-native values and string keys; reject unsupported types before stages; serializer rejects non-string keys, sets and nonfinite floats
m9_pipeline.replay: canonical graph and event hashes exclude wall-clock timestamps/environment metadata; repeated fixture sequence hashes match

scope_cases: bridge removed and restored while both M7 nodes remain; GraphDelta edge diffs verified
room stale preserves last_seen and observation timestamp/revision while packet processing time advances
NavNode stable first_seen and current observation time
immediate membership separated from 0.5 Hz relink/prune cadence; flush applies deferred prune and returns removed node delta
flush ends sequence and timestamp cannot move backwards
mutation-then-downstream-error preserves committed snapshot and requires replay; pre-stage validation does not poison

m9_pipeline.scope: one synthetic offline four-layer integration; direct M4→M5→M8 doorway integration uses synthetic entities; no Habitat/Webots, cloud, whole-pipeline source parity or M11 acceptance
m9_pipeline.failure_policy: pre-stage packet/scheduler validation errors do not poison; exception after a potentially mutating stage preserves last committed graph and poisons this instance; update/flush rejected until close; instantiate new builder and replay
